notes: The diagram shows the pi-stop's 4-pin socket pushed directly onto four adjacent GPIO header pins (GP22, GP27, GP17, GND), so there is no breadboard or jumper wire.
The pi-stop pins in the diagram are labelled R, A, G, GND; R=GPIO22, A (amber)=GPIO27, G=GPIO17.
The GND pin in the diagram is physical pin 9, which is GND.2 in the catalogue's raspberry-pi port naming.
The manual also lists '3x LEDs and resistors' as an alternative but gives no wiring details or diagram, so only the pi-stop build shown in the diagram is modelled.
The software steps (Mu editor, gpiozero code) are not physical parts and are not in the graph.
